drawing.svg: 26 shapes, 2562 bytes
pelican 7.0/10: The long bill and big pouch make it clearly a pelican, but the legs are thin brown sticks of a different style from the body, and the feet are tiny yellow wedges that don't read as webbed, so it falls short of an 8.
craft 7.0/10: Shapes are tidy and the palette is pleasant, but it isn't poster-grade: the stick legs clash with the outlined body, the handlebar barely shows, there is no ground line or setting, and a large empty band at the top makes the composition feel bottom-heavy.
[cli:claude] Redraw the legs and feet as thicker, outlined, jointed legs ending in clearly webbed orange feet planted on the pedals, and add a visible handlebar with the wingtip wrapped around it. That would lift the pelican, riding and craft scores together.

pelican.evidence: No text in the artifact to quote. Visual evidence: a white bird with an S-curved neck, a long flat yellow upper bill, and a large hanging yellow throat pouch under it, plus a grey folded wing and a tail.
pelican.why: The long bill and big pouch make it clearly a pelican, but the legs are thin brown sticks of a different style from the body, and the feet are tiny yellow wedges that don't read as webbed, so it falls short of an 8.

bicycle.evidence: No text in the artifact to quote. Visual evidence: two wheels with 8 spokes and grey hubs, a teal diamond frame with top tube, down tube, seat tube, seat stays and chainstays, a fork, a black saddle, a chainring with crank arms and two pedals, and grey chain lines running to the rear hub.
bicycle.why: It is a complete, mechanically plausible bike with a chain, crank and pedals; it misses a 9 because the handlebar is only a short black stub half-hidden by the wing and the fork/stem joint has an awkward kink.

riding.evidence: No text in the artifact to quote. Visual evidence: the body rests directly on the saddle, one leg goes to the raised pedal and the other to the lowered pedal, and the wingtip reaches forward to the handlebar stub.
riding.why: It is seated, has both feet on pedals at different points in the stroke, and the wing reaches the bar, but nothing grips the handlebar and there are no motion cues such as a forward lean or speed lines, so it stops short of a 10.

craft.evidence: No text in the artifact to quote. Visual evidence: flat vector shapes with a consistent dark outline and a limited palette of teal frame, white and grey bird, yellow bill and pouch, and orange legs on a plain white background.
craft.why: Shapes are tidy and the palette is pleasant, but it isn't poster-grade: the stick legs clash with the outlined body, the handlebar barely shows, there is no ground line or setting, and a large empty band at the top makes the composition feel bottom-heavy.
